name: sideboard
description: Agent-agnostic orchestration layer over git worktrees — your threads aren't trapped anywhere.

scripts.release:npm: pnpm --filter @sideboard-ai/desktop exec node scripts/release.js patch npm
scripts.release:desktop: pnpm --filter @sideboard-ai/desktop exec node scripts/release.js patch mac
scripts.release:local: pnpm --filter @sideboard-ai/desktop exec node scripts/release.js patch all never
